description: What a domain's robots.txt (or llms.txt, tdmrep.json, RSL license, homepage headers) said at a given instant, with the SHA-256 of each version and its EAS attestation anchored on Base. Without `source` it returns the index of versions; with `source` (and optional `at`, RFC 3339) the document in force at that instant. Covers only domains already analysed.

domain.description: Domain to check, without scheme or path (e.g. nytimes.com)

name: signal_history
title: Signal history on any date (free)
